evals.name: python-crm-3d-viz
evals.prompt: Can you give me a 3D visualization of my codebase at demo/tidepool (inside this skill's directory)? I want to see the structure of it like a city or something and watch the data flowing through it like water between the files. Make it interactive so I can rotate it around.
evals.expected_output: A self-contained interactive HTML file showing the repo as a 3D city with buildings per file and animated particle flow along import edges, plus a narration of what the visualization reveals.
assertions: An interactive HTML deliverable exists in the outputs directory
The HTML is fully self-contained: no external scripts, stylesheets, or CDN URLs are loaded (offline-safe)
The visualization is genuinely 3D and user-rotatable (drag/auto-rotate handlers wired up), with animated flow along dependency edges
The embedded data reflects the real target repo: actual file paths appear in the HTML and dependency edges are non-empty
Inputs-to-outputs pipeline: files are staged by dependency depth with a labeled intake (entrypoints) end and a labeled core (most-depended-on) end
The directory hierarchy is visible and labeled in the scene (folder plates or folder tags)
Click-to-trace: clicking a building dims the scene, highlights its dependencies vs dependents in distinct colors, and opens a panel listing both
An aggregated folder-to-folder flow view is available (architecture-level rivers)
The final user-facing response explains how the program works using the pipeline (what's at the intake, what's in the core), naming actual files
